# Baobab v0.35.1 - Table of Contents

> Bamboo append-only logs

## Modules

- [Baobab](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.md): Baobab is a pure Elixir implementation of the
[Bamboo](https://github.com/AljoschaMeyer/bamboo) append-only log.
- [Baobab.ClumpMeta](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.ClumpMeta.md): Functions for interacting with clump metadata
May be useful between consumers to communicate intent

- [Baobab.Entry](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.Entry.md): A struct representing a Baobab entry

- [Baobab.Entry.Validator](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.Entry.Validator.md): Validation of `Baobab.Entry` structs

- [Baobab.Identity](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.Identity.md): Functions related too Baobab identity (keypair) handling

- [Baobab.Interchange](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.Interchange.md): Functions related to the interchange of Bamboo data with
other Bamboo sources

- [Baobab.Persistence](https://baobab.hexdocs.pm/Baobab.Persistence.md): Functions related to Baobab values persistence
